text:
sophie: quick FYI — i'm about to land a terraform change that converts the per-model runtime flags into a namespaced ConfigMap (was a single cluster-scoped cm). goal: let teams toggle flags per-model without kube-level collisions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4567

matt: nice, do we have the migration plan for existing models? worried about old pods reading different keys during rollout.

sophie: good call. plan in the PR description — create new cm in same ns, write keys, then update Deployment to mount new cm path. we do a canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and have a short TTL on the old cache. also will add a readiness probe gating on config load.

alexa: what's the secret sync story? some models read KMS-wrapped secrets for api keys; we shouldn't leak those into the cm.

sophie: correct — secrets stay as Kubernetes Secrets. cm only has flags/runtime knobs (JSON blob) and a reference to secret names. terraform change uses sealed secret references, nothing in plaintext. snippet in PR: 
```hcl
module "model_configs" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//k8s/model-config?ref=v2"
  namespace = var.model_namespace
  configs = { for m in var.models : m.name => { flags = m.flags, secret_refs = m.secret_names } }
}
```

matt: can you paste the k8s manifest we mount? quick sanity check on mountPath so code doesn't expect old /etc/config/default.json path.

sophie: sure: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-runtime-flags-{{ .metadata.name }}
data:
  runtime.json: |
    {
      "enable_new_routing": "false",
      "kv_cache_ttl_ms": "1500"
    }
---
# Deployment change: mount at /etc/model-flags/runtime.json
containers:
- name: runtime
  volumeMounts:
  - name: model-flags
    mountPath: /etc/model-flags/runtime.json
    subPath: runtime.json
volumes:
- name: model-flags
  configMap:
    name: model-runtime-flags-{{ .metadata.name }}
```

julian: ops-bot FYI — we'll need a quick migration runbook and a rollback step if canary shows config drift.

ops-bot: deployment-scheduler: canary rollout scheduled at 2025-10-04T22:00Z for infra/pr-4567. automated rollback window = 20m. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/configmap-migration

alexa: small nit — in code, the loader treats booleans as strings in runtime.json. we should normalize in the agent at load time so toggles aren't fragile. opened a tiny patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987

matt: will review the runtime patch. Sophie, when you land infra PR, can you also post status here with canary logs? just a few samples of config endpoints returning expected keys. :eyes:

sophie: yep — i'll paste pod logs and a couple curl responses after the first canary batch. planning to land in the morning, will tag with :shipit: if green.

matt: thanks. small checklist for PR owner: update terraform state migration note, add e2e smoke test that mounts both old/new path, update docs with new mountPath, and notify internal teams (model-platform + runtime).

sophie: added all to PR checklist. pinging model-platform offline too.

julian: reminder — also update alerts: config-load-failure should be 5xx -> paged for 3m during rollout, not immediate.

sophie: noted. will tweak alerting and mention in the runbook.

matt: 👍

alexa: :rocket:
